content:
17.39 Bitcoin swiped😢

You all know him.

Solid Bitcoin educator.
Been here a long time.
You've enjoyed his posts.

But he was scammed by Coldcard.
Not Bitcoin. And not self-custody.

It think he took advantage of the bear market back in 2022.

This was after the Terra/Luna collapse in May 2022... the Celsius freeze in June... and the Three Arrows Capital blow up in July. 

Bitcoin hovered around 20k.

From my understanding he made all of these purchases on the same exchange about 4 years ago, and then transferred them into his own wallet, generated from a single-sig Coldcard key.

But just a few days ago, due to blatant negligence of epic proportions on Coldcard's side (not performing the function they purported to), his Bitcoin was swiped.

You'd think he'd know better as an educator. And he does. 

As horrific as this is, it's a smaller percentage of his holdings, and he's mostly in multi-signature wallets... thankfully.

But it still hurts. It still represents a lot of sacrifices he made to save that amount. 

(he said I could post without doxxing him, so sharing that it happens to the best of us)

This makes him the 5th largest victim so far.
